lines: One of the men unleashed a hand chop.
Sure enough, there was no doubt.
「You guys are cyborgs, huh? What's your objective?」
Asuka asked the group who had attacked her, while stepping lightly to dodge.
「You're asking that, after attacking me out of nowhere?」
She nimbly dodged another person's fist.
One of them said in apparent surprise, seeing her swift movements.
It appeared that they had finally realized.
Which was a massive difference from Asuka, who had worked that out when they were tailing her.
「You're slow to catch on. And to move, too.」
They appeared to be combat cyborgs, but they were no real threat.
Even though what she currently had on were her everyday limbs, she also had her Wind Escape Arts, so they were always going to be too slow for her.
「I already told you, it's you guys that're slow!」
「There's nothing for it. Our weapons will―――」
「I'm not gonna let you use stuff like that!」
While dodging four people's attacks, Asuka quickly gathered wind into her palms, and
Taking advantage of the fact that their group had gotten closer, she had knocked them down in a flash with wind palm strikes, before they could use their weapons.
If she went all-out, it would be easy to blow their heads off, but her power was quite contained.
This wasn't the place for that. She couldn't do anything too flashy.
Moreover, she had just been scolded by Madam.
「By goods, they probably mean this, huh?」
She looked at the memory card that the strange pickup artist from before had left behind.
「Somehow, I have a feeling I've gotten caught up in some trouble.」
